title: Your Post Code Is the Directions, Not the Destination
summary: CGP Grey explains that postal codes are routing instructions for mail rather than geographic regions. He looks at the quirks and problems this causes.
why: HN recommends it whenever zip codes, addresses or geospatial data come up, as a clear explanation of the hidden pattern in post codes.

quote.text: If you find this interesting and you haven't watched it, Go watch
